verdict.rationale: Salv's documentation describes backtesting transaction-monitoring scenario versions against up to a year of the customer's own history without raising real alerts, before the scenario goes live. It also offers a separate demo sandbox environment. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the backtesting feature, and detail on how test results compare against the active rule.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can test proposed detection rules against historical or sandbox events before activation

citations.quote: Run any scenario version against up to a year of your own history, with no real alerts, and see what it would have caught
Draft a flow, run it against your own history with different settings, and see the alerts it would have raised before it goes live.
